question: is the physically valid part of the prior (phi*Q_ext < 1 everywhere) still uniform in f_beta?
answer: yes. P(valid) is 0.48-0.51 in every f_beta decile and KS(f_beta | valid, Uniform) = 0.0066, at the sampling floor. So the rejection does NOT bias the f_beta marginal, and it is not why the negative control misses KS < 0.1.
side_finding: only 49.7 % of the 7-D prior volume is physically valid. The wasted half is phi and a combinations where the 'all scattered light is lost' model removes more light than arrives.
method: 20000 uniform prior draws, forward model evaluated on each, 950-1800 cm^-1 grid
